audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has only 3 entries (packet defect confirms). Missing a spike covering Lux's W shield absorbing the all-in burst, which is otherwise unmentioned on the page (missingInteractions rule shield-absorbs-burst).
audit.why: Lux W text: 'protecting them from incoming damage' and flag shield: 'absorbs burst — changes all-in maths'.

Light Binding (Q, root), Prismatic Barrier (W, shield), Lucent Singularity (E, slow zone), Final Spark (R, long-range beam) are all named correctly; the root-cancels-engage and R-punishes-the-dive interactions match kit text.
